newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -- Intl Game Technology.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -- Intl Game Technology.

text.p: CS First Boston said it has named International Game Technology its feature stock of the week.
-- Analyst David Anders said he rates the stock a buy with a 12-month price target of $24 per share. Earnings estimates are $1.09 per share for 1997 and $1.35 for 1998.

-- Ander said the recommendation is based on "stable domestic demand for gaming devices, numerous opportunities in international jurisdictions and Native American lands and also accelerated, progressive revenues due to strategic alliances wilth smaller gaming equipment suppliers."
-- Shares were up 1/2 to 18-1/4 in early New York Stock Exchange trade.
